ACTION MINUTES
  CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION

  Special Meeting
  June 15, 2020

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:33 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Gardea, Messina, Sahu, Yee, E. Garcia

  Absent:  Tang, Sanchez

  Commissioner D. Garcia arrived at 6:42 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director, Paul Lam, Principal Planner, Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner, Greg Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  ITEM 1:  MINUTES OF AUGUST 19, 2019
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  ITEM 2:  MINUTES OF JUNE 1, 2020
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  ITEM 3:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TT 82939 & RESIDENTIAL PLANNED
  DEVELOPMENT PERMIT RP-19-15
  • Address: 234 South Marguerita Avenue and 237 South Curtis
  Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for Tentative Tract Map TT 82939
  and Residential Planned Development Permit RP-19-15 to construct
  a 14,994 square foot, eleven (11) unit residential condominium
  complex on a site of approximately 23,556 square feet located in the
  R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Continue to July 6, 2020.
  • Commissioner Sahu requested that Item 3 be removed from the
  Consent Agenda for separate discussion.

  ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-16 & CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-20-1
  • Address: 1301 West Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is an application for Planned Development Permit PD-
  20-16 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-01 to construct a new
  4,950 square foot fully automated car wash on a site of approximately
  1
  6/15/2020
   41,321 square foot parcel located at 1301 West Valley Boulevard in
  the VSP (Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Continue to July 6, 2020.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1 and 2, and continue
  Consent Agenda Item 4 to July 6, 2020.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dunkel-Soto, Seconded by Commissioner
  Messina
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, Gardea, Messina, Sahu, Yee, E.
  Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  D. Garcia, Tang, Sanchez

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1irXKQ3MQs-
  DuuNZ0dT2C8QnVGLXnUany/view

ITEM 3:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TT 82939 & RESIDENTIAL PLANNED
  DEVELOPMENT PERMIT RP-19-15
  • Address: 234 South Marguerita Avenue and 237 South Curtis
  Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for Tentative Tract Map TT 82939
  and Residential Planned Development Permit RP-19-15 to construct
  a 14,994 square foot, eleven (11) unit residential condominium
  complex on a site of approximately 23,556 square feet located in the
  R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Continue to July 6, 2020.
  • This item was removed from the Consent Agenda by Commissioner
  Sahu.
  • Commissioner Questions: Commissioner Sahu stated that prior to
  the meeting, he was contacted by a member of the public concerned
  the public notice carried out for this project. Principal Planner Paul
  Lam responded to Commissioner Sahu’s questions and explained the
  noticing undertaken for this project. Commissioner Dunkel-Soto
  verified with Staff that the project would not need to be renoticed for
  the July 6 meeting.
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1irXKQ3MQs-
  DuuNZ0dT2C8QnVGLXnUany/view

  2
  6/15/2020
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Consent Calendar Item 3 to July 6, 2020.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Messina, Seconded by Commissioner Yee
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Gardea, Messina,
  Sahu, Yee, E. Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Tang, Sanchez

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1irXKQ3MQs-
  DuuNZ0dT2C8QnVGLXnUany/view

D.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  ITEM 5:  INDUSTRIAL PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT IP-19-01 AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-19-01
  • Address: 501 South Marengo Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for an Industrial Planned
  Development Permit (IP-19-1) and Conditional Use Permit (CU-19-
  1) to develop an approximate 53,700 square foot warehouse and
  office facility for Southern California Edison Alhambra Yard. A new
  entrance along South Raymond Avenue and new parking spaces will
  be constructed to accommodate the new warehouse and office facility.
  The project is located on a site of approximately 30.7 acres within the
  Industrial Planned Development zone. A Mitigated Negative
  Declaration (MND) has been prepared for the project.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 20-17 approving the
  Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program and Mitigated
  Negative Declaration, Industrial Planned Development Permit IP-19-
  1 and Conditional Use Permit CU-19-1 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation
  addressing the issues raised at the May 18, 2020, Planning
  Commission meeting.
  • Commissioner Comments: Commissioners appreciated the level of
  collaboration between Staff and the Applicant in addressing the
  complex issues. Commissioner Sahu pointed out typographical
  errors in the staff report. Commissioner Gardea stated his
  preferences for a sidewalk along the Raymond Avenue frontage, and
  for new site landscaping and fencing to match existing conditions for
  a unified appearance. Virginia Loufek, applicant, spoke to
  Commissioner Gardea’s concerns.
  3
  6/15/2020
   •  Public Comments: There were none.
  •  Stephanie Carmorlinga, Engineering Associate, issued an
  amendment to Condition of Approval PW9, which reads: “PW9. The
  east side of South Raymond Avenue shall be red curbed up to 190 feet
  north of the new driveway and up to 100 feet south of the new
  driveway as directed by the Public Works Inspector.”
  •
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Industrial Planned Development IP-19-1 and
  Conditional Use Permit CU-19-1 with Condition of Approval PW9 as
  amended by Staff.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Messina, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dunkel-Soto
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-1
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Yee, E.
  Garcia
  Noes:  Gardea (with comment)
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Tang, Sanchez

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1irXKQ3MQs-
  DuuNZ0dT2C8QnVGLXnUany/view

E.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso informed Commissioners of the City Council’s
  approval of a Resolution adopting vehicle miles traveled (VMT) thresholds of
  significance for the purposes of analyzing transportation impacts under CEQA. She
  added that the Planning Commission will be given a presentation on VMT at the next
  Commission meeting. She also provided a status of The Villages at The Alhambra
  project.

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1irXKQ3MQs-DuuNZ0dT2C8QnVGLXnUany/view

F.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were none.

  4
  6/15/2020
 G.  COMMISSION ORALS:

  There were none.

H.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:31 P.M.
